title: Design System Starter Kit component manifest
description: Schema for manifest.json: the framework-agnostic register of every design system component. Keep this schema in sync with manifest.d.ts, which describes the same structure for TypeScript consumers.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, so editors pick up completion and validation.

version.description: Schema version of the manifest structure. Independent of the package version.

description.description: Explains what the manifest is and how to read it.

components.description: Every component in the design system, in no guaranteed order.

name.description: PascalCase component name, matching the React export and the Storybook title.

cssBlock.description: Primary BEM block class. Components that share a block (ButtonLink reuses dsn-button) repeat it here; their distinction is semantic, not visual.

category.description: Functional category, used for grouping and filtering.

purpose.description: One-sentence English description of what the component does.

platforms.description: Which platform implementations exist for this component.

primaryProps.description: The most important props an implementer needs. Not exhaustive: the component's .docs.md holds the full table. An empty array means the component has no notable props.

name.description: Prop name as used in React (camelCase) or HTML (modifier suffix).

type.description: Type for props that are not enum-style. Use values instead for a fixed set of options.

default.description: Default value. Null means the prop is optional and has no default behaviour.

required.description: Whether the prop must be provided. Omitting it means optional.
